drugs.name: Levodopa
drugs.mechanism: Dopamine precursor converted by DOPA decarboxylase to replenish striatal dopamine
drugs.efficacy: Standard of care for motor symptom management
drugs.adverse_effects: Dyskinesia, nausea, orthostatic hypotension, motor fluctuations

drugs.name: Pramipexole
drugs.mechanism: Non-ergot selective dopamine D2/D3 receptor agonist
drugs.efficacy: Effective monotherapy and adjunct to levodopa
drugs.adverse_effects: Somnolence, impulse control disorders, peripheral edema, hallucinations

drugs.name: Rasagiline
drugs.mechanism: Irreversible selective monoamine oxidase type B (MAO-B) inhibitor
drugs.efficacy: Symptomatic improvement and motor fluctuation reduction

drugs.name: Entacapone
drugs.efficacy: Extends levodopa half-life and reduces OFF time
drugs.adverse_effects: Urine discoloration, diarrhea, dyskinesia exacerbation, nausea

drugs.name: Safinamide
drugs.mechanism: Dual MAO-B inhibitor and glutamate release modulator
drugs.efficacy: Adjunctive therapy for motor fluctuations and OFF episodes

drugs.name: Amantadine
drugs.mechanism: NMDA receptor antagonist and dopamine release promoter
drugs.efficacy: Reduces levodopa-induced dyskinesia and motor symptoms
drugs.adverse_effects: Livedo reticularis, hallucinations, ankle edema, dry mouth
